behaviors.given: the args `--renegotiate-stale 12 --recovery-reason " stale lock "`, and separately each of `--renegotiate-stale 12,13`, `--renegotiate-stale 12,12` and a repeated `--renegotiate-stale`
behaviors.when: the new exported `parseStaleRenegotiationRequest(args)` runs on each, and `parsePipelineRuntimeOptions` runs on the well-formed pair
behaviors.then: the helper returns a request value carrying selector `12` and reason `stale lock`, and refuses the comma-separated list, the duplicated selector inside one value and the second flag occurrence with three distinct messages; the parser calls the helper before the B-12 guard, so those three refusals are observable on the parser too, while the well-formed pair throws B-12's #335 refusal there instead of returning
behaviors.observableResult: unit tests in src/cli-options.test.ts named for B-01 assert the helper's returned selector and reason, assert the three thrown messages are pairwise distinct on both the helper and the parser, and assert the parser throws the #335 refusal for the accepted input

behaviors.given: argument lists with a missing `--recovery-reason` value, a blank value, a repeated `--recovery-reason`, `--renegotiate-stale` alone, and `--recovery-reason` alone
behaviors.then: each case is refused with its own distinct message, the required-together check being one paired-presence check after each flag is parsed independently, following the `--preview-verify-command` / `--preview-apply-command` precedent
behaviors.observableResult: unit tests named for B-02 assert one throw per case and that no two of the five messages are equal, nor equal to any B-01 message

behaviors.given: a persisted run scope and CLI reasons differing only by leading/trailing whitespace, interior spacing, letter case and Unicode composition, plus a selector given once as a slice number and once as a GH issue id
behaviors.when: the exported canonicalizer produces the canonical request
behaviors.then: the reason is the CLI value after ECMAScript `String.prototype.trim()` with no case folding, whitespace collapse or Unicode normalization, and a resolved identity is the pair `{number, ghIssue}` whose `number` comes from `canonicalSliceNumber` resolved against the persisted scope entries — not through `matchesSliceSelector`'s inline `Number(...)` comparison
behaviors.observableResult: unit tests named for B-03 assert the canonical reason bytes for each variant, assert two differently-composed reasons stay distinct, and assert both selector forms resolve to the same `{number, ghIssue}` pair drawn from the persisted scope

behaviors.given: a `RunState.scope` of two slices in a known persisted order
behaviors.when: the exported scope-fingerprint encoder runs over it
behaviors.then: the JSON byte string is exactly `{"mode":<mode>,"slices":[{"number":<canonical>,"ghIssue":<id>}]}` with no insignificant whitespace, in persisted order and in the shown key order emitted explicitly by the encoder, and the fingerprint is its SHA-256 over UTF-8
behaviors.observableResult: a unit test named for B-04 asserts the exact JSON byte string and that its SHA-256 equals an independently computed digest, and asserts the encoder is exported so #335 can call the same one

behaviors.given: a temp repo whose target fails exactly one eligibility predicate — out of persisted scope, no recorded slice branch, missing registered worktree, dirty worktree, no commits ahead of the feature branch, current feature head not contained in the slice branch, invalid or unlocked accepted pair — and a run with no persisted scope at all
behaviors.then: each is refused with that predicate's own stable reason code, the scope of record being `RunState.scope` rather than a re-read of `afk.json`, the recorded branch being `PersistedSliceState.branch` with its absence its own reason, names resolved through src/run-identity.ts, and the predicates composed from the already-exported `hasUncommittedChanges`, `countCommitsAhead` and `isAncestor`
behaviors.observableResult: unit tests named for B-05 assert one distinct reason code per case, that all reason codes are pairwise distinct, and that src/git.ts and src/worktree-processes.ts are unmodified in the diff

behaviors.given: the admission, refusal, snapshot and lock paths in src/preserve-work-recovery.ts and a temp repo whose slice-branch and feature-branch tips are recorded before each path runs
behaviors.when: a source-level check reads the module and each exercised path runs
behaviors.then: no path invokes a git merge, reset or rebase, and every exercised path leaves both tips at their recorded commits
behaviors.observableResult: a unit test named for B-06 asserts the recorded tips are unchanged after every exercised path and that the module's source and call graph contain no merge, reset or rebase invocation

behaviors.given: an eligible target with a locked accepted pair, and separately a publication that fails after the temporary sibling is written
behaviors.then: the eligible case publishes a new directory beneath the target's artifact directory holding byte-identical `contract.md` and `acceptance-manifest.json`, written through a temporary sibling and published atomically only after both files' presence, SHA-256 fingerprints and locked-pair validation agree with the source, with no temporary sibling left and no published directory ever overwritten; the failing case leaves no published directory, appends no lineage and reports pre-admission failure, and a snapshot no `PENDING` event references grants no recovery authority
behaviors.observableResult: unit tests named for B-07 compare both files' bytes, assert no temporary sibling remains, assert a second attempt does not overwrite the published directory, and assert the failure case has no published directory and no lineage

behaviors.given: an eligible target and the admission entry point's own optional `beforeLockAcquired?: () => void` seam, which runs a spawned child process to completion so the accepted pair or the run state's scope changes after snapshot publication and before `transactRunState` takes the lock
behaviors.when: admission acquires the ADR 0056 run-state lock and rechecks the accepted pair, clean worktree, slice head, feature head, active attempt, request identity and canonical scope fingerprint against the facts the snapshot was built from
behaviors.then: the mismatch is a pre-admission refusal that appends no lineage, changes no accepted-pair byte and leaves the published snapshot inert, with `withRunStateLock`, `transactRunState` and `withFileLock`'s `afterLockPublished` keeping their current signatures and behavior and src/file-lock.ts out of scope
behaviors.observableResult: a cross-process contention test named for B-08 asserts the mismatch reason, asserts the run-state file holds no new lineage event, asserts the accepted-pair bytes are unchanged, and asserts the three lock primitives' signatures are untouched in the diff

behaviors.given: an eligible target whose recheck is clean, and separately a target whose last lineage event is already `PENDING`
behaviors.when: admission commits inside the run-state transaction
behaviors.then: the first mutation on disk is exactly one appended `PENDING` event carrying attempt ID, target identity, canonical reason, `extensions: []`, provider name from the caller's run identity, slice branch, slice head, feature head, scope fingerprint, snapshot locator and original pair fingerprints, every other run-state field unchanged; the second admission for the same target is refused and appends nothing
behaviors.observableResult: unit tests named for B-09 assert the run-state diff is that single appended event with those members, assert `extensions` deep-equals [], and assert the second admission is refused with no second event

behaviors.source: GH #277 AC14 (prd.md:122-126, ADR 0018; src/run-state.ts:50-75, :76, :1022, src/eval-boundary.test.ts:127, src/qa-orchestration.test.ts:1028, src/qa-orchestration-gates.test.ts:1043)
behaviors.given: run-state files at every currently supported version, a v7 file whose recovery lineage is malformed, and the three assertions of the run-state version that live outside src/run-state.test.ts
behaviors.when: run state loads, and each of those three assertions runs after the bump
behaviors.then: recovery lineage is one new optional `RunState` field, the version literal at src/run-state.ts:76 is 7 with its change documented in the same running comment block above it (:50-75), a `sanitize`-style reader degrades malformed data to `undefined`, `adaptLoadedState` wires it, the field is read and written only through focused APIs inside the run-state transaction, and each outside assertion reads 7 instead of 6 — src/eval-boundary.test.ts:127 inside PRD 7's `P-05 ... leaves both schema versions alone`, src/qa-orchestration.test.ts:1028 (`expect(state.version).toBe(6)`) and src/qa-orchestration-gates.test.ts:1043 (`expect(bumped.version).toBe(6)`), the latter two reading the version off a loaded state rather than importing `RUN_STATE_VERSION`, which is why an earlier importer survey missed them — one literal per file with nothing else in any of the three files touched
behaviors.observableResult: unit tests named for B-10 assert the version literal is 7, assert the comment block names the v7 addition, and assert malformed lineage degrades to absent; src/eval-boundary.test.ts asserts `RUN_STATE_VERSION` is 7 with `EVENTS_SCHEMA_VERSION` still 1 and its forbidden-import offender list still empty; the two qa-orchestration scenarios assert the loaded version is 7 while their own locked properties still hold unchanged — the #91 approved-baseline locator in src/qa-orchestration.test.ts, and the #91 locator plus #193 applied waivers plus the added `finalEvaluations` record in src/qa-orchestration-gates.test.ts — with no test in either file added, removed, renamed or otherwise edited

behaviors.given: every ordered transition pair over the four lineage states
behaviors.when: the exported transition validator runs on each
behaviors.then: only `PENDING -> COMPLETED`, `PENDING -> ROLLED_BACK`, `PENDING -> ROLLBACK_FAILED` and `ROLLBACK_FAILED -> ROLLED_BACK` are accepted, every other transition including any return to `PENDING` is refused, and the writers append rather than edit or delete an event so a retry is always a new attempt ID
behaviors.observableResult: a table-driven unit test named for B-11 asserts accept/refuse for every pair and asserts a retry produces a new attempt ID with the earlier event still present byte-identical

behaviors.given: a well-formed `--renegotiate-stale` plus `--recovery-reason` pair — the same input B-01's helper returns a request value for — and the three CLI entry sources
behaviors.when: `parsePipelineRuntimeOptions` runs on it and a source-level test reads src/afk.ts, src/afk-claude.ts and src/afk-codex.ts
behaviors.then: the shared parser itself throws a refusal naming #335, after `parseStaleRenegotiationRequest` has validated the flags and before any eligibility check, snapshot or lock acquisition, and each entry reaches its runtime options through `parsePipelineRuntimeOptions`, so all three refuse without any entry file being modified or advertising the flag in its `usage()` text
behaviors.observableResult: unit tests named for B-12 assert the thrown message contains "#335", assert no eligibility, snapshot or lock code executed, and src/cli-entries.test.ts asserts all three entries call the shared parser and that no entry's usage text names either new flag

behaviors.when: the parser runs over each existing flag's accepted and refused inputs after the two new flags are added
behaviors.then: each keeps its current parsing behavior and error text, including `optionValue`'s `` `${flag} requires a value` `` and the paired preview-command message
behaviors.observableResult: unit tests named for P-01 assert the existing accepted results and the exact existing error strings, unchanged from before the slice

behaviors.given: an argument list carrying neither `--renegotiate-stale` nor `--recovery-reason`
behaviors.then: the result equals today's result, no new check runs, no refusal is raised, no new output is produced, the parsed options carry the two new members as `undefined`, and no eligibility, snapshot or lock code executes
behaviors.observableResult: a unit test named for P-02 deep-equals the parsed options against today's expected object, asserts both new members are `undefined` by key, and asserts injected recovery seams recorded zero calls

behaviors.given: run-state files at v3, v4, v5 and v6, and a v7 file carrying no recovery lineage
behaviors.when: run state loads through `adaptLoadedState` and is written back by `writeRunState`
behaviors.then: every currently supported earlier version loads without loss and the no-lineage file round-trips unchanged apart from the version stamp `writeRunState` already applies
behaviors.observableResult: unit tests named for P-03 assert each loaded version's fields survive and assert the round-tripped bytes differ from the input only in the version stamp

behaviors.given: a run state carrying resume counters, slice outcomes, migrations, guardian history, quality stages and other slices' fields
behaviors.when: the lineage writer appends an event through `transactRunState`
behaviors.then: every unrelated run-state field is preserved byte-identically, because the writer mutates only through the run-state transaction
behaviors.observableResult: a unit test named for P-04 diffs the loaded state before and after the append and asserts the recovery-lineage field is the only difference
